# LifeKeel

> The always-on readiness system for your family. LifeKeel continuously
> monitors whether a family is protected — emergency fund, insurance coverage,
> estate documents, retirement trajectory — and surfaces what's missing before
> anyone needs to ask. Not a budgeting app, not an AI financial advisor, not
> a vault. Informational and educational only; not financial, investment, tax,
> or legal advice, and not a substitute for professional emergency services.

LifeKeel is free to start, with no credit card required. It is not an
autonomous financial agent — it does not move money, execute trades, or take
action on a family's behalf without a human approving each step.

## What makes it different

- Continuous detection — 9 YAML-based detectors across protection, savings,
  retirement, education, debt, and estate run on every data change and on a
  daily sweep, even when nobody logs in. Most tools wait for a question.
- Per-member reasoning — each family member (earner, partner, child) gets
  their own digital twin, readiness score, insights, and scenarios scoped to
  their life stage. No competitor found does per-member financial reasoning
  within a shared household.
- Crisis-native — Emergency Mode with 7 event types and step-by-step
  playbooks built from the family's real income, policies, and savings, not
  generic checklists. The closest parallel (Empathy) handles post-event
  support; Keel handles pre-event readiness.
- Structurally neutral — subscription-only revenue (£7.99/mo). Zero
  commissions, zero affiliate links, zero product recommendations. Every
  insurance gap tool, coverage scorer, and "AI advisor" found in market
  research makes money when you buy what they suggest. Keel doesn't.

## Core features (free)

- Emergency Mode — one-tap guided checklist for a specific crisis (medical
  emergency, job loss, bereavement, disability, car, property, travel).
- "What happens if...?" scenarios — member-scoped, multi-step simulations
  with fund-depletion detection and timeline visualization.
- Family Readiness Score — five health domains (protection, wealth, goals,
  savings, estate) with drivers explaining each subscore.
- 9 detectors: protection gap, emergency fund, retirement gap, education
  shortfall, estate readiness, debt-to-income, policy review, education
  pacing, emergency trajectory.
- Document upload and secure storage for insurance policies, pension
  statements, and other financial documents.
- Connect any email provider (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, or custom
  domain) so Keel can watch for financial mail.
- Per-member digital twins — each family member gets their own readiness
  score, insights, and scenarios.
- Adaptive insights — detectors escalate language after repeated fires and
  show what changed since the last alert.
- Annual profile review prompt with a diff of what changed.

## Keel Plus (paid, £7.99/month)

- AI reads uploaded documents and extracts the provider, policy number,
  amount, and dates automatically.
- AI-summarized inbox — financial emails explained in plain language as they
  arrive.
- Priority support.

## Trust and data handling

- Connector passwords and access tokens are encrypted at rest, not just in
  transit.
- Financial data is never sold and is not used to train models beyond the
  request that needs it.
- No commissions, no affiliate links, no partner arrangements with insurers
  or financial product providers.
- Users can ask to have their account and data deleted; this is currently
  handled by a person, not a self-serve flow.
